usage: 起身 is used to describe the action of waking up or getting out of bed.
It commonly appears in daily conversation to talk about morning routines.
It can be combined with time expressions, like 幾點起身? (what time do you wake up?).
起身 can also be used reflexively with pronouns, for example, 我遲咗起身 meaning 'I woke up late'.
In some contexts, 起身 can mean to stand up, depending on the situation.
